question: Which of the following cities is scheduled to host the 2034 Asian Games as per the announcement made by the Olympic Council of Asia on 16 December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __Riyadh__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 2030 Asian Games will be hosted by Doha and the 2034 event by Riyadh.
 
• Qatar will also host the 2022 FIFA World Cup.
 
• The Qatari capital of Doha beat Saudi Arabian counterpart Riyadh for the 2030 Games in the vote at the Olympic Council of Asia's general assembly.
 
• The voting took place on 16 December 2020.
